title: Mercedes-Benz EQS 450+ (2027) drove 539 miles (867 km) on one charge in Edmunds' real-world EV range test: 72 miles (116 km) over its 467-mile (752 km) EPA estimate; longest-range sedan Edmunds has tested, beating the Lucid Air; only the Cadillac Escalade IQ went farther (558 miles, 898 km); 122 kWh battery (up from 118), two-speed rear gearbox, 800 V; ~100 miles (161 km) added in just over 7 minutes; no India launch or price announced
